structured.reason: The mutant stops converting the Provider enum to its string value before building the bucket key. If Provider is not a str subclass, the enum and its string value land in separate buckets. A failure recorded with one form would then not block, and a success would not reset, the same provider/key when the other form is used. That breaks the rule that each failed attempt counts in the state of its own provider and key.
